scripts.clean: rm -rf Cargo.lock && rm -rf tsc && rm -rf target && rm -rf gen && rm -rf resources/worker/bd-wasm-runner.worker.js && cargo clean
scripts.clean:deep: rm -rf node_modules && rm -rf ../node_modules && npm run clean
scripts.build: npm run ts:compile && npm run prodconf && npm run build:worker && cargo tauri build
scripts.build:sidecar: npm run ts:compile && npm run sidecarconf && npm run build:worker && cargo build --release --bin bubbledesk-sidecar
scripts.build:dev: npm run ts:compile && npm run devconf && npm run build:worker && cargo tauri build
scripts.build:log: npm run ts:compile && npm run prodconf && npm run rustbacktrace && npm run build:worker && cargo tauri build
scripts.dev:log: npm run ts:compile && npm run devconf && npm run rustbacktrace && cargo tauri dev
scripts.dev:keepsandbox: npm run ts:compile && npm run devconf && npm run build:worker && npm run keepsandbox && cargo tauri dev
scripts.dev: npm run ts:compile && npm run devconf && npm run build:worker && cargo tauri dev
scripts.dev:sidecar: npm run ts:compile && npm run devconf && npm run build:worker && cargo tauri dev -- --bin bubbledesk-sidecar
scripts.dev:clean: npm run clean && npm run dev
scripts.build:clean: npm run clean && npm run build
